contentSections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
contentSections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top? Strength Plus is an advanced orthopedic medium firm mattress combining memory foam with high-density natural coir, featuring Duroflex's exclusive 5-zone dual density support. It comes with a plush Euro top finish and is wrapped in knitted fabric with memory foam quilting. It’s part of Duroflex’s Duropedic range, which is doctor-recommended for targeted support and exclusively approved by the National Health Academy. 2. What problem does Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top solve? It addresses back pain, poor posture, spinal misalignment, and pressure point discomfort through targeted 5-zone orthopedic support. The dual-density layer contours to natural body curves while maintaining spine alignment. It incorporates naturally cooling coir layers ideal for hot sleepers. The combination of memory foam pressure relief with orthopedic support eliminates the choice between comfort and spinal health. 3. Who is Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top best for? Perfect for desk job professionals with long working hours, those with low-to-medium physical activity, individuals prone to night sweats, back pain sufferers, side and back sleepers seeking pressure relief 4. How does Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top work? Euro top quilted surface provides plush initial comfort; memory foam layer molds to your body and relieves pressure; proprietary 5-zone dual density layer independently adjusts support across five body zones, ensuring each receives customized support based on its weight. The high-density natural coir provides firm structural support while naturally promoting airflow and cooling. 5. How is this mattress different from alternatives? 5-Zone Orthopedic Support: Unlike standard mattresses, this mattress has five targeted support zones, a design recommended by doctors and approved by the National Health Academy Hybrid Construction: It uses a unique combination of adaptive memory foam and natural coir fibers Plush Euro-Top Cover: The mattress has a quilted Euro Top layer that adds cushioning comfort Eco-Friendly Materials: Its cover contains 40% recycled PET yarn 6. How does the Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top feel? The mattress has a “medium” firmness, and the Euro top and memory foam provide gentle pressure relief without excessive softness. Maintains perfect spinal alignment across all sleep positions. 7. Does the Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top come with a warranty? Yes. It comes with a 10-year conditional warranty and 10 Day Replacement Policy. 8. How to care for Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top? Always use a mattress protector to protect against dust, spills, and allergens, and get it professionally deep-cleaned twice a year for better hygiene. Do not flip or turn the mattress, avoid ironing on it, and never fold or bend it as it may damage the mattress structure.
